label: Bible Study
prompt: What? know ye not that your body is the _____ of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
verse: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
note: Paul's reminder to Corinth — the body is a dwelling place, not a rental to trash.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be _____.
verse: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
note: A promise for the 3 a.m. worrier: lie down unafraid, and the sleep itself shall be sweet.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third _____, and was taken up dead.
verse: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
note: Eutychus dozed off during Paul's long sermon and fell from the third loft — Paul revived him, then kept talking till dawn.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he is before all things, and by him all things _____.
verse: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
note: 'Consist' here means hold together — Paul says the glue of the universe has a name.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the _____.
verse: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
note: 'Kick against the pricks' — an ox kicking the farmer's goad, hurting only itself. Saul was the ox.
